summary.en: Get a trade license to operate a business in your city. This is the classic first-permit for small traders: business name, TIN, lease documents, then the license itself from the city trade office.
summary.am: በከተማዎ ውስጥ ንግድ ለመስራት የንግድ ፈቃድ ያግኙ። ይህ ለትናንሽ ነጋዴዎች የመጀመሪያው ፈቃድ ነው፡ የንግድ ስም፣ ታቢ ቁጥር፣ የኪራይ ሰነዶች፣ ከዚያም ፈቃዱ ራሱ።

description.en: Reserve and register the name your business will trade under. In Addis Ababa this is done at the sub-city trade and industry development office. Check the name is available first — names that are identical or too similar to an existing business are rejected.
description.am: ንግድዎ በሚሰራበት ስም ይመዝገቡ። በአዲስ አበባ ይህ በክፍለ ከተማ ንግድና ኢንዱስትሪ ልማት ጽህፈት ቤት ይከናወናል።

responsible_office.en: Sub-city Trade and Industry Development Office (or Ministry of Trade and Regional Integration for federal processes)
responsible_office.am: የክፍለ ከተማ ንግድና ኢንዱስትሪ ልማት ጽህፈት ቤት

description.en: Every business needs a TIN before the license can be issued. Register at the nearest Ministry of Revenues branch. You can use the dedicated TIN registration checklist in this app alongside this one.
description.am: ፈቃድ ከመሰጠቱ በፊት እያንዳንዱ ንግድ ታቢ ቁጥር ሊኖረው ይገባል።

responsible_office.en: Ministry of Revenues (branch office)

title.en: Secure premises and prepare lease documents
title.am: የንግድ ቦታ ይያዙና የኪራይ ሰነዶችን ያዘጋጁ

description.en: The trade office will verify your business premises. You need a notarized lease agreement (or proof of ownership if you own the property) plus the landlord's ID copy and a property tax clearance if required locally.

responsible_office.en: Notary office + sub-city administration
responsible_office.am: የኖታሪ ጽህፈት ቤት + የክፍለ ከተማ አስተዳደር

label.en: Notarized lease agreement or ownership deed

description.en: Assemble the full application: the application form from the trade office, your name registration certificate, TIN certificate, lease documents, ID copies and photos. Submit at the sub-city trade office counter and get a receipt/queue reference.
description.am: ሙሉ ማመልከቻውን ያዘጋጁና በክፍለ ከተማ ንግድ ጽህፈት ቤት ያቅርቡ።

responsible_office.en: Sub-city Trade and Industry Development Office
responsible_office.am: የክፍለ ከተማ ንግድና ኢንዱስትሪ ልማት ጽህፈት ቤት

title.en: Pay the license fee and collect your license

description.en: Once approved, pay the license fee at the designated bank/cashier (fees vary by business type and capital) and return with the receipt to collect your trade license. Verify the business name and address on the license before leaving the counter.
description.am: ጸድቆ ከተጠናቀቀ በኋላ ክፍያውን ይክፈሉና ፈቃድዎን ይቀበሉ።

responsible_office.en: Sub-city Trade and Industry Development Office
responsible_office.am: የክፍለ ከተማ ንግድና ኢንዱስትሪ ልማት ጽህፈት ቤት

common_rejection_reasons.en: Business name already registered or too similar to an existing name
common_rejection_reasons.am: የንግድ ስሙ ቀድሞ የተመዘገበ ወይም ከነባር ስም ጋር ተመሳሳይ ነው

common_rejection_reasons.en: Lease agreement not notarized or premises could not be verified
common_rejection_reasons.am: የኪራይ ውሉ ያልተረጋገጠ ወይም ቦታው ሊረጋገጥ አልቻለም

common_rejection_reasons.en: Missing TIN certificate or mismatch between TIN and ID details
Incomplete application file (missing photos, copies, or form)
Business activity not covered by the requested license category
common_rejection_reasons.am: እንቅስቃሴው በተጠየቀው የፈቃድ ምድብ ውስጥ የለም

notes.en: Addis Ababa sub-city offices handle the full process. Queues are long in some sub-cities — go early in the morning and bring extra copies of everything.
notes.am: የአዲስ አበባ ክፍለ ከተማ ጽህፈት ቤቶች ሙሉውን ሂደት ይይዛሉ።

notes.en: Handled by the Amhara Region Trade Bureau in Bahir Dar. Fees and timelines are similar; name registration is federal via the Ministry of Trade's system.
notes.am: በባህር ዳር በአማራ ክልል የንግድ ቢሮ ይከናወናል።
